html: In a knee replacement, a surgeon removes the worn surfaces of the joint and fits new ones made of metal and medical-grade plastic. It's most often done for knees damaged by arthritis.

image.caption: Rehab exercises begin within a day or so and continue for weeks.
image.title: Illustration of a knee joint

html:
• People whose knee pain makes walking, stairs or getting out of a chair hard
  • People whose knee pain keeps them up at night
  • People whose stiffness or swelling hasn't improved with medicine, physical therapy or injections

Most people go home the same day or within a couple of days and use a walker or cane at first. Daily exercises are key. Many people return to everyday activities in about six weeks and keep improving for months.
